entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Sayyida Ruqayya Mosque is a Twelver Shia mosque and mausoleum complex, located in Damascus, Syria. The complex contains the grave of Sukainah, also known as "Ruqayya", the young daughter of Al-Husayn ibn Ali.
